metadata.name: 心智娘 · 菌花巡游
metadata.tips: Her little cape is straightened and the fungal flowers are ready. She calls the trip a symbiotic habitat survey. The itinerary contains exactly three items: take a walk, find you, and take a walk with you. Apparently she already knows what the survey will discover.
